title: Predictable identifier via uniqid (php) — review required
description: The php call uniqid generates an identifier from the current time and a small counter, so values are guessable and collide under load. It is not a source of unguessable tokens. For security values use random_bytes. This lexical rule flags the call; whether the value guards anything is reviewed separately.
remediation: Use a cryptographic source (random_bytes) for tokens and identifiers that must not be guessable.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the uniqid call; the value’s security role is a review question.
